### Nehemiah’s Pleas to God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/nehemiahs-pleas-to-god
Passage: Nehemiah 13:14
Points:
- Nehemiah frequently concluded his acts of leadership by asking God to remember his faithful service.
- Believers can humbly appeal to God for His blessing based on sincere obedience, while acknowledging imperfection.
- While Nehemiah was away, the people quickly compromised and stopped providing tithes for the Levites.
- Nehemiah returned to rectify the neglect, reinstalling the ministers and restoring material support for worship.
- God notes the deeds done for His house and will graciously reward those zealous for His service.
